question: In a code language, 'ALMOND' is coded as LAOMDN and 'RAISIN' is coded as ARSINI. How will 'CASHEW' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ALMOND' is coded as 'LAOMDN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d2e2e16cfca97932b3a26f2162c57cf29f621b1a031b47196e3a96e8eee10b1.png] 

'RAISIN' is coded as 'ARSINI',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/878e738b85955ed70d045cbe81eb21fe76f319732ac55d6b80525f2956231caa.png] 

Similarly, for '**CASHEW**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd7717d471c835ae9912443d254934ed56cdb2c752a047af886901207b0502dd.png] 

So, '**CASHEW**' will be coded as '**ACHSWE**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
